updated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the worker wrote the file

scan_interval_seconds.description: Nominal seconds between scans (from config / SCAN_INTERVAL_SECONDS env) for stale-dashboard logic

field_set.description: Q3: full rows match Telegram-oriented fields; minimal omits per-exchange volumes and ohlcv_source

scan_duration_s.description: Q20: optional wall-clock scan duration in seconds when worker attaches scan health

coins_evaluated.description: Q20: optional count of exchange symbols considered in the scan

errors_count.description: Q20: optional sum of metrics error counters for the scan

cmc_slug.description: CoinMarketCap /currencies/{slug}/ path segment when resolved from map or learn file (G8)

backtest_top_strategies.description: Present in field_set full when scanner attached backtest rows (Q13 parity)

backtest_buy_hold.description: Optional buy-and-hold summary object when field_set full

chart_image_url.description: Optional HTTPS URL to a chart image; shown in dashboard expanded row when field_set full (Q19)
